# Function: process()

```ts
function process(options): ProcessHandle;
```

Defined in: src/specification/facets/\_common/process.ts:149

Declare an external process the framework owns for the life of the
specification.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `options` | [`ProcessOptions`](../type-aliases/ProcessOptions.md) |

## Returns

[`ProcessHandle`](../classes/ProcessHandle.md)

## Example

```ts
const { website, cleanup } = await specification.website({
      services: { api: process({ command: 'bin/server web', ready: '/health' }) },
      server: ({ api }) => process({
          command: 'next dev',
          env: { NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: api.connectionString },
      }),
  });
```
